### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|avatar_uuid|string|false|write-only|The UUID of the Avatar of the MonetaryAccountBank.|
|country_iban|string|false|write-only|The country of the monetary account IBAN.|
|currency|string|true|none|The currency of the MonetaryAccountBank as an ISO 4217 formatted currency code.|
|daily_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The daily spending limit Amount of the MonetaryAccountBank. Defaults to 1000 EUR. Currency must match the MonetaryAccountBank's currency. Limited to 10000 EUR.|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the MonetaryAccountBank. Defaults to 'bunq account'.|
|display_name|string|false|none|The legal name of the user / company using this monetary account.|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountBank, can only be OTHER. Should only be specified if updating the status to CANCELLED.|
|reason_description|string|false|none|The optional free-form reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountBank. Can be any user provided message. Should only be specified if updating the status to CANCELLED.|
|setting|[MonetaryAccountSetting](#schemamonetaryaccountsetting)|false|none|The settings of the MonetaryAccountBank.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the MonetaryAccountBank. Ignored in POST requests (always set to ACTIVE) can be CANCELLED or PENDING_REOPEN in PUT requests to cancel (close) or reopen the MonetaryAccountBank. When updating the status and/or sub_status no other fields can be updated in the same request (and vice versa).|
|sub_status|string|false|none|The sub-status of the MonetaryAccountBank providing extra information regarding the status. Should be ignored for POST requests. In case of PUT requests with status CANCELLED it can only be REDEMPTION_VOLUNTARY, while with status PENDING_REOPEN it can only be NONE. When updating the status and/or sub_status no other fields can be updated in the same request (and vice versa).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alias|[[Pointer](#schemapointer)]|false|none|The Aliases to add to MonetaryAccountJoint. Must all be confirmed first. Can mostly be ignored.|
|all_co_owner|[[CoOwner](#schemacoowner)]|true|none|The users the account will be joint with.|
|avatar_uuid|string|false|write-only|The UUID of the Avatar of the MonetaryAccountJoint.|
|currency|string|true|none|The currency of the MonetaryAccountJoint as an ISO 4217 formatted currency code.|
|daily_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The daily spending limit Amount of the MonetaryAccountJoint. Defaults to 1000 EUR. Currency must match the MonetaryAccountJoint's currency. Limited to 10000 EUR.|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the MonetaryAccountJoint. Defaults to 'bunq account'.|
|overdraft_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The maximum Amount the MonetaryAccountJoint can be 'in the red'. Must be 0 EUR or omitted.|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountJoint, can only be OTHER. Should only be specified if updating the status to CANCELLED.|
|reason_description|string|false|none|The optional free-form reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountJoint. Can be any user provided message. Should only be specified if updating the status to CANCELLED.|
|setting|[MonetaryAccountSetting](#schemamonetaryaccountsetting)|false|none|The settings of the MonetaryAccountJoint.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the MonetaryAccountJoint. Ignored in POST requests (always set to ACTIVE) can be CANCELLED or PENDING_REOPEN in PUT requests to cancel (close) or reopen the MonetaryAccountJoint. When updating the status and/or sub_status no other fields can be updated in the same request (and vice versa).|
|sub_status|string|false|none|The sub-status of the MonetaryAccountJoint providing extra information regarding the status. Should be ignored for POST requests. In case of PUT requests with status CANCELLED it can only be REDEMPTION_VOLUNTARY, while with status PENDING_REOPEN it can only be NONE. When updating the status and/or sub_status no other fields can be updated in the same request (and vice versa).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|all_co_owner|[[CoOwner](#schemacoowner)]|false|none|The users the account will be joint with.|
|avatar_uuid|string|false|write-only|The UUID of the Avatar of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|currency|string|true|none|The currency of the MonetaryAccountSavings as an ISO 4217 formatted currency code.|
|daily_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The daily spending limit Amount of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Defaults to 1000 EUR. Currency must match the MonetaryAccountSavings's currency. Limited to 10000 EUR.|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Defaults to 'bunq account'.|
|reason|string|false|none|The reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountSavings, can only be OTHER. Should only be specified if updating the status to CANCELLED.|
|reason_description|string|false|none|The optional free-form reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountSavings. Can be any user provided message. Should only be specified if updating the status to CANCELLED.|
|savings_goal|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Savings Goal set for this MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|setting|[MonetaryAccountSetting](#schemamonetaryaccountsetting)|false|none|The settings of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Ignored in POST requests (always set to ACTIVE) can be CANCELLED or PENDING_REOPEN in PUT requests to cancel (close) or reopen the MonetaryAccountSavings. When updating the status and/or sub_status no other fields can be updated in the same request (and vice versa).|
|sub_status|string|false|none|The sub-status of the MonetaryAccountSavings providing extra information regarding the status. Should be ignored for POST requests. In case of PUT requests with status CANCELLED it can only be REDEMPTION_VOLUNTARY, while with status PENDING_REOPEN it can only be NONE. When updating the status and/or sub_status no other fields can be updated in the same request (and vice versa).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alias|[[Pointer](#schemapointer)]|false|read-only|The Aliases for the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|all_auto_save_id|[[BunqId](#schemabunqid)]|false|read-only|The ids of the AutoSave.|
|all_co_owner|[[CoOwner](#schemacoowner)]|false|read-only|The users the account will be joint with.|
|avatar|[Avatar](#schemaavatar)|false|none|The Avatar of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|balance|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The current available balance Amount of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the MonetaryAccountSavings's creation.|
|currency|string|false|read-only|The currency of the MonetaryAccountSavings as an ISO 4217 formatted currency code.|
|daily_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The daily spending limit Amount of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Defaults to 1000 EUR. Currency must match the MonetaryAccountSavings's currency. Limited to 10000 EUR.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Defaults to 'bunq account'.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|monetary_account_profile|[MonetaryAccountProfile](#schemamonetaryaccountprofile)|false|none|The profile of the account.|
|overdraft_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The maximum Amount the MonetaryAccountSavings can be 'in the red'. Must be 0 EUR or omitted.|
|public_uuid|string|false|read-only|The MonetaryAccountSavings's public UUID.|
|reason|string|false|read-only|The reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountSavings, can only be OTHER.|
|reason_description|string|false|read-only|The optional free-form reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountSavings. Can be any user provided message.|
|savings_goal|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Savings Goal set for this MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|savings_goal_progress|integer|false|read-only|The progress in percentages for the Savings Goal set for this MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|setting|[MonetaryAccountSetting](#schemamonetaryaccountsetting)|false|none|The settings of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Can be: ACTIVE, BLOCKED, CANCELLED or PENDING_REOPEN|
|sub_status|string|false|read-only|The sub-status of the MonetaryAccountSavings providing extra information regarding the status. Will be NONE for ACTIVE or PENDING_REOPEN, COMPLETELY or ONLY_ACCEPTING_INCOMING for BLOCKED and REDEMPTION_INVOLUNTARY, REDEMPTION_VOLUNTARY or PERMANENT for CANCELLED.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the MonetaryAccountSavings's last update.|
|user_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the User who owns the MonetaryAccountSavings.|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|alias|[[Pointer](#schemapointer)]|false|read-only|The Aliases for the MonetaryAccountSavings.|

|all_co_owner|[[CoOwner](#schemacoowner)]|false|read-only|The users the account will be joint with.|
|avatar|[Avatar](#schemaavatar)|false|none|The Avatar of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|balance|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The current available balance Amount of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the MonetaryAccountSavings's creation.|
|currency|string|false|read-only|The currency of the MonetaryAccountSavings as an ISO 4217 formatted currency code.|
|daily_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The daily spending limit Amount of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Defaults to 1000 EUR. Currency must match the MonetaryAccountSavings's currency. Limited to 10000 EUR.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Defaults to 'bunq account'.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|monetary_account_profile|[MonetaryAccountProfile](#schemamonetaryaccountprofile)|false|none|The profile of the account.|
|overdraft_limit|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The maximum Amount the MonetaryAccountSavings can be 'in the red'. Must be 0 EUR or omitted.|
|public_uuid|string|false|read-only|The MonetaryAccountSavings's public UUID.|
|reason|string|false|read-only|The reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountSavings, can only be OTHER.|
|reason_description|string|false|read-only|The optional free-form reason for voluntarily cancelling (closing) the MonetaryAccountSavings. Can be any user provided message.|
|savings_goal|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Savings Goal set for this MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|savings_goal_progress|integer|false|read-only|The progress in percentages for the Savings Goal set for this MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|setting|[MonetaryAccountSetting](#schemamonetaryaccountsetting)|false|none|The settings of the MonetaryAccountSavings.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the MonetaryAccountSavings. Can be: ACTIVE, BLOCKED, CANCELLED or PENDING_REOPEN|
|sub_status|string|false|read-only|The sub-status of the MonetaryAccountSavings providing extra information regarding the status. Will be NONE for ACTIVE or PENDING_REOPEN, COMPLETELY or ONLY_ACCEPTING_INCOMING for BLOCKED and REDEMPTION_INVOLUNTARY, REDEMPTION_VOLUNTARY or PERMANENT for CANCELLED.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the MonetaryAccountSavings's last update.|
|user_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the User who owns the MonetaryAccountSavings.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|string|false|none|The notification category that will match this notification filter. Possible choices are BILLING, CARD_TRANSACTION_FAILED, CARD_TRANSACTION_SUCCESSFUL, CHAT, DRAFT_PAYMENT, IDEAL, SOFORT, MONETARY_ACCOUNT_PROFILE, MUTATION, PAYMENT, PROMOTION, REQUEST, SCHEDULE_RESULT, SCHEDULE_STATUS, SHARE, SUPPORT, TAB_RESULT, USER_APPROVAL.|
|notification_delivery_method|string|false|none|The delivery method via which notifications that match this notification filter will be delivered. Possible choices are PUSH for delivery via push notification and URL for delivery via URL callback.|
|notification_target|string|false|none|The target of notifications that match this notification filter. For URL notification filters this is the URL to which the callback will be made. For PUSH notifications filters this should always be null.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|A billing Address provided with the Payment, currently unused.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|A shipping Address provided with the Payment, currently unused.|
|alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount containing the public information of 'this' (party) side of the Payment.|
|allow_bunqto|boolean|false|write-only|Whether or not sending a bunq.to payment is allowed.|
|amount|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Amount transferred by the Payment. Will be negative for outgoing Payments and positive for incoming Payments (relative to the MonetaryAccount indicated by monetary_account_id).|
|attachment|[[AttachmentMonetaryAccountPayment](#schemaattachmentmonetaryaccountpayment)]|false|none|The Attachments attached to the Payment.|
|balance_after_mutation|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The new balance of the monetary account after the mutation.|
|batch_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the PaymentBatch if this Payment was part of one.|
|bunqto_expiry|string|false|read-only|When bunq.to payment is about to expire.|
|bunqto_share_url|string|false|read-only|The status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_status|string|false|read-only|The status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_sub_status|string|false|read-only|The sub status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the bunq.to payment was responded to.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount containing the public information of the other (counterparty) side of the Payment.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Payment was done.|
|description|string|false|none|The description for the Payment. Maximum 140 characters for Payments to external IBANs, 9000 characters for Payments to only other bunq MonetaryAccounts.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The Geolocation where the Payment was done from.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the created Payment.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|none|Optional data included with the Payment specific to the merchant.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccount the Payment was made to or from (depending on whether this is an incoming or outgoing Payment).|
|payment_auto_allocate_instance|[PaymentAutoAllocateInstance](#schemapaymentautoallocateinstance)|false|none|A reference to the PaymentAutoAllocateInstance if it exists.|
|request_reference_split_the_bill|[[RequestInquiryReference](#schemarequestinquiryreference)]|false|read-only|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be RequestInquiry or RequestInquiryBatch|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the JobScheduled if the Payment was scheduled.|
|sub_type|string|false|read-only|The sub-type of the Payment, can be PAYMENT, WITHDRAWAL, REVERSAL, REQUEST, BILLING, SCT, SDD or NLO.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The type of Payment, can be BUNQ, EBA_SCT, EBA_SDD, IDEAL, SWIFT or FIS (card).|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Payment was last updated (will be updated when chat messages are received).|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|A billing Address provided with the Payment, currently unused.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|A shipping Address provided with the Payment, currently unused.|
|alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount containing the public information of 'this' (party) side of the Payment.|
|amount|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Amount transferred by the Payment. Will be negative for outgoing Payments and positive for incoming Payments (relative to the MonetaryAccount indicated by monetary_account_id).|
|attachment|[[AttachmentMonetaryAccountPayment](#schemaattachmentmonetaryaccountpayment)]|false|read-only|The Attachments attached to the Payment.|
|balance_after_mutation|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The new balance of the monetary account after the mutation.|
|batch_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the PaymentBatch if this Payment was part of one.|
|bunqto_expiry|string|false|read-only|When bunq.to payment is about to expire.|
|bunqto_share_url|string|false|read-only|The status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_status|string|false|read-only|The status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_sub_status|string|false|read-only|The sub status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the bunq.to payment was responded to.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount containing the public information of the other (counterparty) side of the Payment.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Payment was done.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description for the Payment. Maximum 140 characters for Payments to external IBANs, 9000 characters for Payments to only other bunq MonetaryAccounts.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The Geolocation where the Payment was done from.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the created Payment.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|read-only|Optional data included with the Payment specific to the merchant.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccount the Payment was made to or from (depending on whether this is an incoming or outgoing Payment).|
|payment_auto_allocate_instance|[PaymentAutoAllocateInstance](#schemapaymentautoallocateinstance)|false|none|A reference to the PaymentAutoAllocateInstance if it exists.|
|request_reference_split_the_bill|[[RequestInquiryReference](#schemarequestinquiryreference)]|false|read-only|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be RequestInquiry or RequestInquiryBatch|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the JobScheduled if the Payment was scheduled.|
|sub_type|string|false|read-only|The sub-type of the Payment, can be PAYMENT, WITHDRAWAL, REVERSAL, REQUEST, BILLING, SCT, SDD or NLO.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The type of Payment, can be BUNQ, EBA_SCT, EBA_SDD, IDEAL, SWIFT or FIS (card).|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Payment was last updated (will be updated when chat messages are received).|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|A billing Address provided with the Payment, currently unused.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|A shipping Address provided with the Payment, currently unused.|

|amount|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Amount transferred by the Payment. Will be negative for outgoing Payments and positive for incoming Payments (relative to the MonetaryAccount indicated by monetary_account_id).|
|attachment|[[AttachmentMonetaryAccountPayment](#schemaattachmentmonetaryaccountpayment)]|false|read-only|The Attachments attached to the Payment.|
|balance_after_mutation|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The new balance of the monetary account after the mutation.|

|bunqto_share_url|string|false|read-only|The status of the bunq.to payment.|

|bunqto_sub_status|string|false|read-only|The sub status of the bunq.to payment.|
|bunqto_time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the bunq.to payment was responded to.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount containing the public information of the other (counterparty) side of the Payment.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Payment was done.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description for the Payment. Maximum 140 characters for Payments to external IBANs, 9000 characters for Payments to only other bunq MonetaryAccounts.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The Geolocation where the Payment was done from.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the created Payment.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|read-only|Optional data included with the Payment specific to the merchant.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccount the Payment was made to or from (depending on whether this is an incoming or outgoing Payment).|
|payment_auto_allocate_instance|[PaymentAutoAllocateInstance](#schemapaymentautoallocateinstance)|false|none|A reference to the PaymentAutoAllocateInstance if it exists.|
|request_reference_split_the_bill|[[RequestInquiryReference](#schemarequestinquiryreference)]|false|read-only|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be RequestInquiry or RequestInquiryBatch|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the JobScheduled if the Payment was scheduled.|
|sub_type|string|false|read-only|The sub-type of the Payment, can be PAYMENT, WITHDRAWAL, REVERSAL, REQUEST, BILLING, SCT, SDD or NLO.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The type of Payment, can be BUNQ, EBA_SCT, EBA_SDD, IDEAL, SWIFT or FIS (card).|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Payment was last updated (will be updated when chat messages are received).|

|membership_settled|[RegistryMembership](#schemaregistrymembership)|false|none|The membership of the user that has settled the registry.|
|number_of_entries|integer|false|read-only|The number of RegistryEntry's associated with this RegistrySettlement.|
|settled_by_alias|[RegistryMembership](#schemaregistrymembership)|false|none|The membership of the user that settled the Registry.|
|settlement_time|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the Registry's settlement.|
|total_amount_spent|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The total amount spent for the RegistrySettlement.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the RegistrySettlement's last update.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the RegistrySettlement's creation.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the RegistrySettlement.|
|items|[[RegistrySettlementItem](#schemaregistrysettlementitem)]|false|read-only|List of RegistrySettlementItems|
|membership_settled|[RegistryMembership](#schemaregistrymembership)|false|none|The membership of the user that has settled the registry.|
|number_of_entries|integer|false|read-only|The number of RegistryEntry's associated with this RegistrySettlement.|
|settled_by_alias|[RegistryMembership](#schemaregistrymembership)|false|none|The membership of the user that settled the Registry.|
|settlement_time|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the Registry's settlement.|
|total_amount_spent|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The total amount spent for the RegistrySettlement.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the RegistrySettlement's last update.|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The billing address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The shipping address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|allow_amount_higher|boolean|false|write-only|[DEPRECATED] Whether or not the accepting user can choose to accept with a higher amount than requested. Defaults to false.|
|allow_amount_lower|boolean|false|write-only|[DEPRECATED] Whether or not the accepting user can choose to accept with a lower amount than requested. Defaults to false.|
|allow_bunqme|boolean|true|write-only|Whether or not sending a bunq.me request is allowed.|
|amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The requested amount.|
|amount_responded|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The responded amount.|
|attachment|[[BunqId](#schemabunqid)]|false|none|The attachments attached to the payment.|
|batch_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the batch if the request was part of a batch.|
|bunqme_share_url|string|false|read-only|The url that points to the bunq.me request.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount the money was requested from.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's creation.|
|description|string|false|none|The description of the inquiry.|
|event_id|integer|false|write-only|The ID of the associated event if the request was made using 'split the bill'.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The geolocation where the payment was done.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the created RequestInquiry.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|none|The client's custom reference that was attached to the request and the mutation.|
|minimum_age|integer|false|none|The minimum age the user accepting the RequestInquiry must have.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the monetary account the request response applies to.|
|redirect_url|string|false|none|The URL which the user is sent to after accepting or rejecting the Request.|
|reference_split_the_bill|[RequestReferenceSplitTheBillAnchorObject](#schemarequestreferencesplitthebillanchorobject)|false|none|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be Payment, PaymentBatch, ScheduleInstance, RequestResponse and MasterCardAction|
|require_address|string|false|none|Whether or not an address must be provided on accept.|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the scheduled job if the request was scheduled.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the request.|
|time_expiry|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request expired.|
|time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request was responded to.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's last update.|
|user_alias_created|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|
|user_alias_revoked|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|
|want_tip|boolean|false|write-only|[DEPRECATED] Whether or not the accepting user can give an extra tip on top of the requested Amount. Defaults to false.|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|event_id|integer|false|write-only|The ID of the associated event if the request batch was made using 'split the bill'.|
|reference_split_the_bill|[RequestReferenceSplitTheBillAnchorObject](#schemarequestreferencesplitthebillanchorobject)|false|none|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be Payment, PaymentBatch, ScheduleInstance, RequestResponse and MasterCardAction|
|request_inquiries|[[RequestInquiry](#schemarequestinquiry)]|false|none|The list of requests that were made.|
|status|string|false|write-only|The status of the request.|
|total_amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The total amount originally inquired for this batch.|

|total_amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The total amount originally inquired for this batch.|


### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The billing address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The shipping address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The requested amount.|
|amount_responded|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The responded amount.|
|attachment|[[BunqId](#schemabunqid)]|false|read-only|The attachments attached to the payment.|
|batch_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the batch if the request was part of a batch.|
|bunqme_share_url|string|false|read-only|The url that points to the bunq.me request.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount the money was requested from.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's creation.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description of the inquiry.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The geolocation where the payment was done.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the created RequestInquiry.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|read-only|The client's custom reference that was attached to the request and the mutation.|
|minimum_age|integer|false|read-only|The minimum age the user accepting the RequestInquiry must have.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the monetary account the request response applies to.|
|redirect_url|string|false|read-only|The URL which the user is sent to after accepting or rejecting the Request.|
|reference_split_the_bill|[RequestReferenceSplitTheBillAnchorObject](#schemarequestreferencesplitthebillanchorobject)|false|none|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be Payment, PaymentBatch, ScheduleInstance, RequestResponse and MasterCardAction|
|require_address|string|false|read-only|Whether or not an address must be provided on accept.|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the scheduled job if the request was scheduled.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the request.|
|time_expiry|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request expired.|
|time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request was responded to.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's last update.|
|user_alias_created|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|
|user_alias_revoked|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The billing address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The shipping address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The requested amount.|
|amount_responded|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The responded amount.|
|attachment|[[BunqId](#schemabunqid)]|false|read-only|The attachments attached to the payment.|
|batch_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the batch if the request was part of a batch.|
|bunqme_share_url|string|false|read-only|The url that points to the bunq.me request.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount the money was requested from.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's creation.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description of the inquiry.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The geolocation where the payment was done.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the created RequestInquiry.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|read-only|The client's custom reference that was attached to the request and the mutation.|
|minimum_age|integer|false|read-only|The minimum age the user accepting the RequestInquiry must have.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the monetary account the request response applies to.|
|redirect_url|string|false|read-only|The URL which the user is sent to after accepting or rejecting the Request.|
|reference_split_the_bill|[RequestReferenceSplitTheBillAnchorObject](#schemarequestreferencesplitthebillanchorobject)|false|none|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be Payment, PaymentBatch, ScheduleInstance, RequestResponse and MasterCardAction|
|require_address|string|false|read-only|Whether or not an address must be provided on accept.|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the scheduled job if the request was scheduled.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the request.|
|time_expiry|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request expired.|
|time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request was responded to.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's last update.|
|user_alias_created|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|
|user_alias_revoked|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The billing address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The shipping address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The requested amount.|
|amount_responded|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The responded amount.|
|attachment|[[BunqId](#schemabunqid)]|false|read-only|The attachments attached to the payment.|
|batch_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the batch if the request was part of a batch.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount the money was requested from.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's creation.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description of the inquiry.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The geolocation where the payment was done.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the payment request.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|read-only|The client's custom reference that was attached to the request and the mutation.|
|minimum_age|integer|false|read-only|The minimum age the user accepting the RequestInquiry must have.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the monetary account the request response applies to.|
|reference_split_the_bill|[RequestReferenceSplitTheBillAnchorObject](#schemarequestreferencesplitthebillanchorobject)|false|none|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be Payment, PaymentBatch, ScheduleInstance, RequestResponse and MasterCardAction|
|require_address|string|false|read-only|Whether or not an address must be provided on accept.|
|scheduled_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the scheduled job if the request was scheduled.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the request.|
|time_expiry|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request expired.|
|time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the payment request was responded to.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the payment request's last update.|
|user_alias_created|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|
|user_alias_revoked|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label that's displayed to the counterparty with the mutation. Includes user.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The billing address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The shipping address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount this RequestResponse was received on.|
|amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The requested Amount.|
|amount_responded|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Amount the RequestResponse was accepted with.|
|attachment|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|read-only|The Attachments attached to the RequestResponse.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount that is requesting money with this RequestResponse.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Request Response was created.|
|credit_scheme_identifier|string|false|read-only|The credit scheme id provided by the counterparty for DIRECT_DEBIT inquiries.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description for the RequestResponse provided by the requesting party. Maximum 9000 characters.|
|eligible_whitelist_id|integer|false|read-only|The whitelist id for this action or null.|
|event_id|integer|false|read-only|The ID of the latest event for the request.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The Geolocation where the RequestResponse was created.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the Request Response.|
|mandate_identifier|string|false|read-only|The mandate id provided by the counterparty for DIRECT_DEBIT inquiries.|
|minimum_age|integer|false|read-only|The minimum age the user accepting the RequestResponse must have.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccount the RequestResponse was received on.|
|redirect_url|string|false|read-only|The URL which the user is sent to after accepting or rejecting the Request.|
|request_reference_split_the_bill|[[RequestInquiryReference](#schemarequestinquiryreference)]|false|read-only|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be RequestInquiry or RequestInquiryBatch|
|require_address|string|false|read-only|Whether or not an address must be provided on accept.|
|status|string|false|none|The status of the RequestResponse. Can be ACCEPTED, PENDING, REJECTED, REFUND_REQUESTED, REFUNDED or REVOKED.|
|sub_type|string|false|read-only|The subtype of the RequestInquiry. Can be ONCE or RECURRING for DIRECT_DEBIT RequestInquiries and NONE for all other.|
|time_expiry|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the RequestResponse expired or will expire.|
|time_refund_requested|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when a refund request for the RequestResponse was claimed.|
|time_refunded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the RequestResponse was refunded.|
|time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the RequestResponse was responded to.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The type of the RequestInquiry. Can be DIRECT_DEBIT, DIRECT_DEBIT_B2B, IDEAL, SOFORT or INTERNAL.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Request Response was last updated (will be updated when chat messages are received).|
|user_refund_requested|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label of the user that requested the refund.|

|address_billing|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The billing address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|address_shipping|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The shipping address provided by the accepting user if an address was requested.|
|alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount this RequestResponse was received on.|
|amount_inquired|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The requested Amount.|
|amount_responded|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The Amount the RequestResponse was accepted with.|
|attachment|[[Attachment](#schemaattachment)]|false|read-only|The Attachments attached to the RequestResponse.|
|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount with the public information of the MonetaryAccount that is requesting money with this RequestResponse.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Request Response was created.|
|credit_scheme_identifier|string|false|read-only|The credit scheme id provided by the counterparty for DIRECT_DEBIT inquiries.|
|description|string|false|read-only|The description for the RequestResponse provided by the requesting party. Maximum 9000 characters.|
|eligible_whitelist_id|integer|false|read-only|The whitelist id for this action or null.|
|event_id|integer|false|read-only|The ID of the latest event for the request.|
|geolocation|[Geolocation](#schemageolocation)|false|none|The Geolocation where the RequestResponse was created.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the Request Response.|
|mandate_identifier|string|false|read-only|The mandate id provided by the counterparty for DIRECT_DEBIT inquiries.|
|minimum_age|integer|false|read-only|The minimum age the user accepting the RequestResponse must have.|
|monetary_account_id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the MonetaryAccount the RequestResponse was received on.|
|redirect_url|string|false|read-only|The URL which the user is sent to after accepting or rejecting the Request.|
|request_reference_split_the_bill|[[RequestInquiryReference](#schemarequestinquiryreference)]|false|read-only|The reference to the object used for split the bill. Can be RequestInquiry or RequestInquiryBatch|
|require_address|string|false|read-only|Whether or not an address must be provided on accept.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the RequestResponse. Can be ACCEPTED, PENDING, REJECTED, REFUND_REQUESTED, REFUNDED or REVOKED.|
|sub_type|string|false|read-only|The subtype of the RequestInquiry. Can be ONCE or RECURRING for DIRECT_DEBIT RequestInquiries and NONE for all other.|
|time_expiry|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the RequestResponse expired or will expire.|
|time_refund_requested|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when a refund request for the RequestResponse was claimed.|
|time_refunded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the RequestResponse was refunded.|
|time_responded|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of when the RequestResponse was responded to.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The type of the RequestInquiry. Can be DIRECT_DEBIT, DIRECT_DEBIT_B2B, IDEAL, SOFORT or INTERNAL.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp when the Request Response was last updated (will be updated when chat messages are received).|
|user_refund_requested|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The label of the user that requested the refund.|

|counterparty_alias|[LabelMonetaryAccount](#schemalabelmonetaryaccount)|false|none|The LabelMonetaryAccount containing the public information of the other (counterparty) side of the Payment.|
|description|string|false|none|The description for the Payment. Maximum 140 characters for Payments to external IBANs, 9000 characters for Payments to only other bunq MonetaryAccounts.|
|merchant_reference|string|false|none|Optional data included with the Payment specific to the merchant.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|

|address_main|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The company's main address.|
|address_postal|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The company's postal address.|
|alias|[[Pointer](#schemapointer)]|false|read-only|The aliases of the account.|
|avatar|[Avatar](#schemaavatar)|false|none|The company's avatar.|
|avatar_uuid|string|false|write-only|The public UUID of the company's avatar.|
|billing_contract|[[BillingContractSubscription](#schemabillingcontractsubscription)]|false|read-only|The subscription of the company.|
|chamber_of_commerce_number|string|false|none|The company's chamber of commerce number.|
|counter_bank_iban|string|false|read-only|The company's other bank account IBAN, through which we verify it.|
|country|string|false|none|The country as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the company object's creation.|
|customer|[Customer](#schemacustomer)|false|none|The customer profile of the company.|
|customer_limit|[CustomerLimit](#schemacustomerlimit)|false|none|The customer limits of the company.|
|daily_limit_without_confirmation_login|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The amount the company can pay in the session without asking for credentials.|
|deny_reason|string|false|read-only|The user deny reason.|
|directors|[[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)]|false|read-only|The existing bunq aliases for the company's directors.|
|display_name|string|false|read-only|The company's display name.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the modified company.|
|language|string|false|none|The person's preferred language. Formatted as a ISO 639-1 language code plus a ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, seperated by an underscore.|
|legal_form|string|false|none|The company's legal form.|
|name|string|false|none|The company name.|
|notification_filters|[[NotificationFilter](#schemanotificationfilter)]|false|read-only|The types of notifications that will result in a push notification or URL callback for this UserCompany.|
|public_nick_name|string|false|none|The company's public nick name.|
|public_uuid|string|false|read-only|The company's public UUID.|
|region|string|false|none|The person's preferred region. Formatted as a ISO 639-1 language code plus a ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, seperated by an underscore.|
|relations|[[RelationUser](#schemarelationuser)]|false|read-only|The relations for this user.|
|sector_of_industry|string|false|read-only|The sector of industry.|
|session_timeout|integer|false|none|The setting for the session timeout of the company in seconds.|
|status|string|false|none|The user status. Can be: ACTIVE, SIGNUP, RECOVERY.|
|sub_status|string|false|none|The user sub-status. Can be: NONE, FACE_RESET, APPROVAL, APPROVAL_DIRECTOR, APPROVAL_PARENT, APPROVAL_SUPPORT, COUNTER_IBAN, IDEAL or SUBMIT.|
|tax_resident|[[TaxResident](#schemataxresident)]|false|read-only|The user's tax residence numbers for different countries.|
|type_of_business_entity|string|false|read-only|The type of business entity.|
|ubo|[[Ubo](#schemaubo)]|false|none|The names of the company's ultimate beneficiary owners. Minimum zero, maximum four.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the company object's last update.|
|version_terms_of_service|string|false|read-only|The version of the terms of service accepted by the user.|

|notification_filters|[[NotificationFilter](#schemanotificationfilter)]|false|read-only|The types of notifications that will result in a push notification or URL callback for this UserCompany.|
|public_nick_name|string|false|read-only|The company's public nick name.|
|public_uuid|string|false|read-only|The company's public UUID.|
|region|string|false|read-only|The person's preferred region. Formatted as a ISO 639-1 language code plus a ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, seperated by an underscore.|
|relations|[[RelationUser](#schemarelationuser)]|false|read-only|The relations for this user.|
|sector_of_industry|string|false|read-only|The sector of industry.|
|session_timeout|integer|false|read-only|The setting for the session timeout of the company in seconds.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The user status. Can be: ACTIVE, SIGNUP, RECOVERY.|
|sub_status|string|false|read-only|The user sub-status. Can be: NONE, FACE_RESET, APPROVAL, APPROVAL_DIRECTOR, APPROVAL_PARENT, APPROVAL_SUPPORT, COUNTER_IBAN, IDEAL or SUBMIT.|
|tax_resident|[[TaxResident](#schemataxresident)]|false|read-only|The user's tax residence numbers for different countries.|
|type_of_business_entity|string|false|read-only|The type of business entity.|
|ubo|[[Ubo](#schemaubo)]|false|read-only|The names of the company's ultimate beneficiary owners. Minimum zero, maximum four.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the company object's last update.|
|version_terms_of_service|string|false|read-only|The version of the terms of service accepted by the user.|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|address_main|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The person's main address.|
|address_postal|[Address](#schemaaddress)|false|none|The person's postal address.|
|alias|[[Pointer](#schemapointer)]|false|read-only|The aliases of the user.|
|avatar|[Avatar](#schemaavatar)|false|none|The user's avatar.|
|country_of_birth|string|false|read-only|The person's country of birth. Formatted as a SO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.|
|created|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the person object's creation.|
|daily_limit_without_confirmation_login|[Amount](#schemaamount)|false|none|The amount the user can pay in the session without asking for credentials.|
|date_of_birth|string|false|read-only|The person's date of birth. Accepts ISO8601 date formats.|
|display_name|string|false|read-only|The display name for the person.|
|first_name|string|false|read-only|The person's first name.|
|gender|string|false|read-only|The person's gender. Can be MALE, FEMALE or UNKNOWN.|
|id|integer|false|read-only|The id of the modified person object.|
|language|string|false|read-only|The person's preferred language. Formatted as a ISO 639-1 language code plus a ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, seperated by an underscore.|
|last_name|string|false|read-only|The person's last name.|
|legal_name|string|false|read-only|The person's legal name.|
|middle_name|string|false|read-only|The person's middle name.|
|nationality|string|false|read-only|The person's nationality. Formatted as a SO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.|
|notification_filters|[[NotificationFilter](#schemanotificationfilter)]|false|read-only|The types of notifications that will result in a push notification or URL callback for this UserPerson.|
|place_of_birth|string|false|read-only|The person's place of birth.|
|public_nick_name|string|false|read-only|The public nick name for the person.|
|public_uuid|string|false|read-only|The person's public UUID.|
|region|string|false|read-only|The person's preferred region. Formatted as a ISO 639-1 language code plus a ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, seperated by an underscore.|
|relations|[[RelationUser](#schemarelationuser)]|false|read-only|The relations for this user.|
|session_timeout|integer|false|read-only|The setting for the session timeout of the user in seconds.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The user status. The user status. Can be: ACTIVE, BLOCKED, SIGNUP, RECOVERY, DENIED or ABORTED.|
|sub_status|string|false|read-only|The user sub-status. Can be: NONE, FACE_RESET, APPROVAL, APPROVAL_DIRECTOR, APPROVAL_PARENT, APPROVAL_SUPPORT, COUNTER_IBAN, IDEAL or SUBMIT.|
|tax_resident|[[TaxResident](#schemataxresident)]|false|read-only|The user's tax residence numbers for different countries.|
|updated|string|false|read-only|The timestamp of the person object's last update.|
|version_terms_of_service|string|false|read-only|The version of the terms of service accepted by the user.|

|monetary_account_paying_id|integer|false|read-only|The account from which payments will be deducted when a transaction is matched with this whitelist.|
|status|string|false|read-only|The status of the whitelist.|
|type|string|false|read-only|The type of the SDD whitelist, can be CORE or B2B.|
|user_alias_created|[LabelUser](#schemalabeluser)|false|none|The user who created the whitelist entry.|
